en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 8. Muḥammad ibn Ja’far Al-Razzāz narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain ibn Abil Khaťťāb, from Muḥammad ibn Ismā’īl, from Abil Maghrā (Ḥumayd ibn Muthannā Al-Sayrafi), from Abī Basīr, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
The Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) said, “Women are the light of my eyes and Ḥasan and Ḥusain (a.s.) are my two flowers.”
